blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The shear line, northeast monsoon, easterlies and intertropical convergence zone (ITCZ) will bring rains and thunderstorms over parts of the country on Sunday, the state weather bureau said. In its 4 a.m. weather forecast, the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) said the shear line will affect the eastern sections of Northern and Central Luzon, while the northeast monsoon, or “amihan,” will prevail over the rest of Northern Luzon. Pagasa said cloudy skies with scattered rains and isolated thunderstorms will prevail over mainland Cagayan, Isabela, Nueva Vizcaya, Quirino, and Aurora due to the shear line. Similar […]...
